Company policy requires that the approved package address three key areas before I can authorize filing: ownership clearance, technical claim support for draft claims C1 through C5, and territorial coverage -- including a decision on the foreign filing route. Has everyone had a chance to review the draft claims and come prepared today?

commitments.detail: Obtain written university consent or license for C1 subject matter before any filing including C1 can be authorized. Add this condition to the filing checklist.
C2 and C4 are removed from the application due to lack of enabling data across stated operating ranges. Narrower supported claims may be pursued if properly supported.
C5 is included as the priority commercial claim. C3 is omitted as it does not align with the immediate commercial objective.
Filing package must be reconfigured to include both US and EP filing routes to preserve European rights for the German first market.

Filing is not authorized until ownership clearance for C1 is resolved, the claim set is finalized as C5 only (with C2, C3, and C4 removed), and the EP filing route is incorporated into the package. Resubmit for authorization once all conditions are met.
